scope: Every declared nonnull vtable target has complete original ELF/GNU ownership and matching bytes. Indirect JR/JALR sites are unobserved instructions within those bodies; they are not accepted virtual calls. Other original code, non-vtable callbacks, runtime receiver/slot edges, signatures and natural behavior remain separate. No game bytes, SDK semantics or features are recovered by export.
